277660854.description:
Natural Mineral Specimen Set
Amethyst and Smoky Quartz (Morion)
Total Weight: 2 lbs
This natural mineral specimen set features two distinct geological formations: a vibrant Amethyst crystal cluster and a large, dark Smoky Quartz (Morion) terminated point. The Amethyst displays a dense druzy formation with rich violet tones, while the Smoky Quartz specimen showcases a primary prismatic termination accented by secondary crystal growths at the base. These earth-mined specimens are ideal for geological study, mineral collections, or decorative display.
Natural Amethyst cluster with multiple faceted crystal terminations
Dark Smoky Quartz (Morion) point with distinct prismatic habit
Raw geological matrix preserved on the underside of specimens
Total set dimensions approximately 5 x 5 x 3 inches
Condition:
Good pre-owned condition. Natural mineral specimens with inherent geological characteristics. The Amethyst crystals are intact with consistent coloration. The Smoky Quartz point shows sharp edges and natural surface textures; any internal veining or minor surface irregularities are consistent with raw earth-mined stones. No significant post-extraction damage observed.
